metadata.description: Standards bypass configuration for this branch

bypass.reason: list is the one verb that takes no arguments: a no-args gate would print introspection in place of `drone @skills list`, the branch's main verb. The module's introspection is reached by `list --help` (pinned in tests/test_discovery.py). Remove if the entry point ever passes list a filter argument.
copytree has already copied the file; a binary file has no {{SKILL_NAME}} to replace, so skipping it is the right answer, not a stand-in.
Only the 'created' date is defaulted: rewriting over an unreadable state document is the operator's recovery path. read_state still fails closed.
find_spec raising ModuleNotFoundError means a parent package is absent, so the package is missing; reporting it missing is the answer, not a stand-in.

notes.usage: Add entries to 'bypass' list to exclude specific violations

example.reason: Circular dependency - logger cannot import CLI

fields.standard: Standard name: cli, imports, naming, etc. (required)
fields.lines: Optional - specific line numbers to bypass
